item.summary: fix(cron): terminalize the receipt when a mutation fences a queued reservation (#123725) A disable/remove that lands while a scheduled run is still queued on admission wipes the durable queuedAtMs marker. The executor's fence branch then dropped only the in-memory reservation, leaving the run receipt 'running' and locally owned: recovery skips it (no durable markers, live pid), and every later reservation hits the receipt-conflict monitor, so an enabled job with a due next run never fires again until gateway restart. Finish the receipt as skipped in the fence branch, mirroring the manual-run and not-runnable siblings.
